_README: The register of catechumen and Baptism/Chrismation documents. `npm run catechumens` renders it into the resource cards on catechumens.html and into the three document pages, and regenerates DOCUMENTS-FOR-FR-JOHN.md. This file is the ONE place a document's title, status and date live: the card and the document itself are stamped from the same entry, so they cannot disagree, and there is no second copy of a document anywhere on this site to go stale.
_rules: ONE canonical version. A document lives at exactly one URL. Other pages LINK to it; they never restate it. If two pages would say the same thing, one of them is wrong within a month — that is the whole reason this register exists.
`lastUpdated` is stamped onto the card and onto the document from this entry alone. Change it here when the content changes, and both move together.

Everything about Baptism, Chrismation, Confession, Holy Communion, fasting, godparent eligibility, sacramental preparation and reception into the Church is PASTORAL CONTENT. It carries `governance: "pastoral"`, and its `items` stay empty until Fr. John supplies them. The build refuses to publish a pastoral document that has content but no `approvedBy`.

`status` is one of: awaiting (nothing written yet), outline (the structure is published, the requirements are not), published (Fr. John's content is in). A card says which, in as many words, on its face.
`needs` is what Fr. John would have to supply for the entry to move on. It is not shown on the website — it is what DOCUMENTS-FOR-FR-JOHN.md is built from.
